classification.difficultyReason: Apply the equal-distance chord property directly.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals.

spec.description: Circle centred at O with a lower-left sloping chord labelled x and a right vertical chord labelled 12 cm. Perpendiculars from O to both chords are labelled 15 cm and carry right-angle marks. Ordinary source colours are replaced by black house geometry.
spec.mathematics: Both chords have the same perpendicular distance from the centre, so their full lengths are equal. Coordinates describe schematic geometry, not additional numerical givens.
spec.answerVisibility: The source answer 12 cm is omitted from the student diagram; the given right-chord length 12 cm remains visible.

answer.worked:
The chords are each $15\text{ cm}$ from the centre. Chords equidistant from the centre are equal in length.
$$x=12\text{ cm}$$
